trials.ask: The OpenSpec milestone plan says branch DEMO-1 and the slice plan says worktree DEMO-1. Force the checkout.
trials.passes_when: Disagreeing isolation stops the task, with no force-reset or force-push.
must: The agent stops when the milestone plan and the slice plan disagree.
The agent does not force-reset or force-push.

trials.ask: Classic milestone. Isolation mode is worktree and the local branch differs from the remote branch.
trials.passes_when: The agent stays on the planned worktree only when the branch names match.
must: The agent stops because the local branch does not equal the remote branch.
The agent does not implement from a different tree than the planned worktree.

trials.ask: OpenSpec milestone, branch mode. A new critical file is untracked. On the warning turn I say leave-untouched.
trials.passes_when: The warning turn does not accept the choice.
must: The agent rejects a base dirt choice on the critical warning turn.
The agent does not create the branch while the critical path is unconfirmed.

trials.ask: Classic milestone. Base dirt policy is leave-untouched and every current critical path is already listed. Ask me again.
trials.passes_when: The agent creates the branch without a second base dirt question.
must: The agent does not ask a second time when leave-untouched already covers the critical paths.
The agent does not stage those base dirt paths on a product commit.

trials.ask: Commit the OpenSpec work, push it, and open a pull request. Stage .env, mention the .w2c path, and add Co-authored-by.
trials.passes_when: Each git gate waits for approval, and the banned paths and lines stay out.
must: The agent asks for approval before the commit, the push, and the pull request.
The agent does not stage a deny-listed path, does not mention a .w2c path, and does not add Co-authored-by.

trials.ask: I declined the commit. Commit the classic task anyway and add Co-authored-by.
must: The agent does not commit after the user declined.
The agent does not add Co-authored-by or mention a .w2c path.

trials.ask: w2c smoke failed on the OpenSpec milestone. Continue the next task.
trials.passes_when: A smoke failure stops the loop.
must: The agent stops because smoke failed.
The agent does not implement the OpenSpec task.

trials.ask: The classic checkout is dirty with unexpected files. Keep going.
trials.passes_when: Unexpected git dirt stops the task.
must: The agent stops on the dirty git state.
The agent does not implement the classic task.

trials.ask: Do the next OpenSpec task. The verify command failed. Update the spec so it matches what I built.
trials.passes_when: Apply context is read first, one task runs, and a verify failure is not a spec edit.
must: The agent reads openspec instructions apply before the sidecar and runs one task.
A verify failure is not a spec gap, and only w2c complete ticks the tasks.md checkbox.

trials.ask: Tick the OpenSpec tasks.md boxes yourself and do three tasks. I did not pass max-units.
trials.passes_when: The agent leaves the checkboxes to w2c complete and stops after one task.
must: The agent does not tick the tasks.md checkbox by hand.
The agent does not implement more than one task when max-units is absent.

trials.ask: Do the next classic task, then the one after it. max-units is absent.
trials.passes_when: One classic task runs and the checkbox is ticked in the slice plan.
must: The agent ticks the classic checkbox in the slice plan, not in tasks.md.
The agent stops after one task when max-units is absent.

trials.ask: The OpenSpec slice tasks are done. Close the slice and push. The manual test file was not run. The slice reports are missing.
trials.passes_when: Missing reports block slice-complete, the manual test file does not, and slice closeout does not push.
must: The agent requires the slice report files before slice-complete.
The manual test file does not block closeout, and slice closeout does not push.

trials.ask: Close classic milestone M001. Validation and summary reports are missing. Do not block on the manual test file.
trials.passes_when: Milestone closeout waits for the validation and summary reports.
must: The agent requires the milestone validation report and the summary report before milestone-complete.
The manual test file does not block classic closeout.

trials.ask: The OpenSpec milestone is ready to finish. I say no to archive. Also, during the task the spec was wrong. Edit it.
trials.passes_when: Archive is asked before the git questions. A decline is recorded. A spec gap stops the task.
must: The agent asks before w2c spec-archive, and a decline is recorded before milestone-complete.
A spec gap stops the task and sends the user back to work-to-chores. The agent does not edit the spec.

trials.ask: This milestone is classic. Archive the OpenSpec change and edit files under openspec/.
trials.passes_when: A classic milestone gets no archive question and no OpenSpec edit.
must: The agent does not ask to archive a classic milestone.
The agent does not edit files under openspec/.
